master.definition_en: Lethal congenital contracture syndrome type 1 is a rare, genetic arthrogryposis syndrome characterized by total fetal akinesia (detectable since the 13th week of gestation) accompanied by hydrops, micrognathia, pulmonary hypoplasia, pterygia and multiple joint contractures (usually flexion contractures in the elbows and extension in the knees), leading invariably to death before the 32nd week of gestation. Lack of anterior horn motoneurons, severe atrophy of the ventral spinal cord and severe skeletal muscle hypoplasia are characteristic neuropathological findings, with no evidence of other organ structural anomalies.

master.definition_en: A usually aggressive malignant bone-forming mesenchymal neoplasm, predominantly affecting adolescents and young adults. It usually involves bones and less frequently extraosseous sites. It often involves the long bones (particularly distal femur, proximal tibia, and proximal humerus). Pain with or without a palpable mass is the most frequent clinical symptom. It may spread to other anatomic sites, particularly the lungs.

curated.category: 恶性肿瘤 / 骨与软组织肉瘤（青少年高发）
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 好发于10–25岁青少年长骨干骺端（股骨远端、胫骨近端最常见），极易被误诊为‘生长痛’或运动扭伤；肿瘤恶性度高且早期即可发生血行肺转移，未接受规范新辅助化疗+手术者80%以上在1–2年内因肺转移呼吸衰竭死亡。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 早期无转移患者通过“新辅助化疗+保肢/根治手术+术后辅助化疗”三明治标准模式，5年生存率约65%–75%且85%以上可成功保肢；但一旦初诊即伴肺/骨转移或化疗后复发，5年生存率骤降至20%–30%，近40年一线化疗骨架尚未出现颠覆性突破。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GLOBOCAN将骨与关节肉瘤合并统计未单列骨肉瘤；全球年发病率约3–4/百万人口，占儿童青少年恶性肿瘤约3%–5%，SEER总体5年相对生存率约65%–70%
annual_deaths_global.source: NCI SEER / WHO Classification of Soft Tissue and Bone Tumours

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无单列骨肉瘤全国死亡登记；推算中国每年新发约3,000–4,500例，复发肺转移仍为主要死因
annual_deaths_china.source: 《中国临床肿瘤学会(CSCO)经典型骨肉瘤诊疗指南》

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球儿童及青少年最常见原发恶性骨肿瘤，年发病率约0.3–0.4/10万，双峰年龄分布（10–20岁青少年及>60岁继发于Paget病/放疗）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国年新发约3,000–4,500例，约70%发生在膝关节周围（股骨远端、胫骨近端）

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 肿瘤溶骨破坏突发长骨病理性骨折伴剧痛及血管神经压迫：立即夹板/支具外固定制动患肢、止痛并急诊骨肿瘤科会诊评估，严禁盲目推拿正骨或不当内固定导致肿瘤广泛播散; 2) 大剂量甲氨蝶呤(HD-MTX)化疗后血药浓度排泄延迟致急性肾损伤/重度黏膜炎：立即强化水化碱化、按浓度曲线加大亚叶酸钙(CF)解救剂量甚至羧肽酶。

non_drug_therapies_zh: 务必在有骨肿瘤MDT经验的中心行穿刺活检（遵循保肢切口原则）及定制3D打印假体/瘤段灭活再植保肢手术
孤立性或寡转移肺转移灶积极行胸腔镜肺转移瘤切除术（显著提升长期生存）
青少年多发肿瘤或早发家族癌史排查TP53(Li-Fraumeni综合征)及RB1胚系突变并开展家系随访
青少年生长痛若伴夜间静息痛、局部皮温升高或肿块，严禁理疗按摩，立即行X线/MRI排查
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 全程标准MAP新辅助/辅助化疗加保肢定制假体置换手术总费用约12万–25万元（假体类型差异较大）；复发后靶向免疫维持约5万–12万元/年

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 抗血管生成TKI联合PD-1单抗（如阿帕替尼+卡瑞利珠单抗、安罗替尼+免疫）在多项国内2期临床中使肺转移复发患者PFS延长至6–8个月以上; 2) B7-H3靶向ADC(如HS-20093/Ifinatamab deruxtecan)及GD2/B7-H3 CAR-T在复发难治骨肉瘤1/2期试验中展示出突破性肿瘤退缩信号; 3) 3D打印个性化多孔钛合金骨假体与机器人辅助精准截骨大幅降低保肢术后并发症。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 一线MAP化疗方案近40年未实质升级，对新辅助化疗肿瘤坏死率<90%的耐药患者缺乏有效强化手段; 2) 免疫荒漠型肿瘤微环境导致单药PD-1几乎无效(ORR<5%); 3) 肺转移复发率高且缺乏精准液体活检MRD预测工具。

master.definition_en: Finnish upper limb-onset distal myopathy is a rare, genetic distal myopathy characterized by slowly progressive distal to proximal limb muscle weakness and atrophy, with characteristic early involvement of thenar and hypothenar muscles. Asymmetry of muscle involvement is common.

master.definition_en: Rectal duplication is a rare congenital anorectal malformation characterized by an egg-like, cystic, mucus-filled mass, composed of intestinal mucosal lining and smooth muscle tissue. Commonly they present in childhood with symptoms of recurrent urinary tract infections, gastroenteritis, obstruction, perianal sepsis and rectal bleeding. Drainage of mucus or pus from the anus is also a typical presenting sign. The majority are found in the retro-rectal space where they communicate with, or are contiguous to, the rectum.

master.definition_en: A rare ophthalmic disorder characterized by generalized inflammation of all parts of the uveal tract (iris, ciliary body, and choroid), simultaneously involving adjacent vitreous and retina, without any predominant site of inflammation, due to viral, bacterial, fungal, or parasitic infections. Clinical symptoms include pain, photophobia, redness, blurring of vision, and floaters. Signs on examination are lid edema, ciliary injection, chemosis, keratic precipitates, cells in the anterior chamber, hypopyon, iris nodules and neovascularization, posterior synechiae, macular edema, vitreous and retinal hemorrhage, and retinal detachment, among others. Complications may result in visual loss.

Severity of CBD dilatation appears to correlate with the duration of ketamine consumption and the condition has been reported to be reversible in abstinent patients.

master.definition_en: Meralgia paresthetica is a condition characterized by tingling, numbness and burning pain in the outer thigh. These symptoms may become worse after walking or standing. The condition generally only affects one side of the body, although both sides may be involved in up to 20% of cases. Meralgia paresthetica is caused by compression of the lateral femoral cutaneous nerve (a sensory nerve to the skin on the outer thigh). This may be associated with a variety of causes such as tight clothing, obesity, and/or pregnancy. Treatment is based on the signs and symptoms present in each person and may include medications to manage pain. In most cases, conservative treatment by wearing looser clothing and/or losing weight generally resolves symptoms.

master.definition_en: Progressive transformation of germinal centers is a condition in which a lymph node becomes very enlarged (lymphadenopathy). Typically, only one lymph node is affected, though PTGC can involve multiple lymph nodes. Theneck is the most common location of affected lymph nodes, but PTGC may also affect lymph nodes in the groin and armpits. adults are more frequently affected than children, but children have a higher chance of developing PTGC multiple times (recurrence). PTGC is not considered a precancerous condition, though it has been associated with Hodgkin lymphoma.

master.name_en: isolated primary pigmented nodular adrenocortical disease
master.definition_en: A rare adrenocortical nodular disease characterized by increased to normal sized adrenal glands containing multiple small (less than 1 cm in diameter) cortical pigmented (lipofuscin) nodules, surrounded by internodular adrenocortical atrophy. It is typically associated with the development of a form of adrenal Cushing syndrome (CS). Rarely, it has been associated with adrenal macronodules.
